ControlPropertyState.AutoRuleBindingString:
Text(CountRows(HomeGallery.AllItems)) & If(CountRows(HomeGallery.AllItems) = 1, "  request", "  requests") & "   " &
If(
    CountIf(HomeGallery.AllItems, Status.Value = "Rejected") > 0,
    "⚠  " & Text(CountIf(HomeGallery.AllItems, Status.Value = "Rejected")) & " rejected",
    If(
        CountRows(HomeGallery.AllItems) > 0
        And CountIf(HomeGallery.AllItems, Status.Value = "Approved") = CountRows(HomeGallery.AllItems),
        "✓  all approved",
        If(
            CountIf(HomeGallery.AllItems, Status.Value = "Draft") > 0,
            "◌  " & Text(CountIf(HomeGallery.AllItems, Status.Value = "Draft")) & " in draft",
            ""
        )
    )
)
"No requests yet — press \"+  New request\" to create your first one."

If(
    varFilter = "All",
    Filter('Coverage Request (Belgium)', 'Created By'.Email = User().Email),
    Filter('Coverage Request (Belgium)', 'Created By'.Email = User().Email, Status.Value = varFilter)
)
